notes: Two live defects, reported together. 1. A dangling reference blanked the view The heat map rendered exactly this and nothing else: > ⚠ no cohort "coh_ay3fa4yq" — list_cohorts shows 505 available A cohort id was persisted in saved client state, the cohort had since been deleted, the server refused correctly, and the client turned that refusal into a dead panel. The bug is not the refusal. The slice was gone; the surface was not. A persisted *pointer* to a deleted object is a filter the user can no longer have, not a fatal condition for the whole view.
